name: [Part 1] synchronous waves and threshold
input: basic propagation with one source and a threshold-two cell
test:
original = [[1, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]]
assert simulate_basic(original) == (4, [[1, 1, 1], [1, 1, 1], [1, 1, 1]])
assert original == [[1, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0], [0, 0, 0]]
assert simulate_basic([[1, 0, 1]], infection_threshold=2) == (1, [[1, 1, 1]])

name: [Part 2] immune barrier remains static
input: infected cells separated from healthy cells by immune plants

name: [Part 3] infection timers create a moving wave
test:
assert simulate_recovery([[1, 0, 0]], infectious_days=1) == (3, [[2, 2, 2]])
assert simulate_recovery([[1, 2, 0]], infectious_days=2) == (2, [[2, 2, 0]])

name: [Part 4] doom is sticky until the recovery day
input: newly infected middle plant crosses the death threshold
test:
assert simulate_pending_death([[1, 0, 1]], infectious_days=1, death_threshold=2) == (2, 1, [[2, 3, 2]])
assert simulate_pending_death([[1, 0]], infectious_days=1, death_threshold=2) == (2, 0, [[2, 2]])
assert simulate_pending_death([[1, 1, 1]], infectious_days=1, death_threshold=1) == (1, 3, [[3, 3, 3]])

name: [Part 5] burn minimizes deaths then stabilization time
input: one-cell tie and a non-trivial three-by-three grid
test:
assert best_initial_burn([[1]], 1, 2) == (0, 0, 'row', 0, [[4]])
scenario = [[0, 0, 1], [0, 0, 1], [1, 1, 0]]
result = best_initial_burn(scenario, 2, 2)
assert result[:4] == (1, 4, 'row', 1)
assert scenario == [[0, 0, 1], [0, 0, 1], [1, 1, 0]]

name: [All parts] validate malformed grids and thresholds
input: empty, ragged, unknown-state, and non-positive inputs
